# meta-flywheel-mcp

> Zero-dependency Python MCP server for Meta Graph, Instagram Pro & Threads publishing, auto-chained replies, and idempotent Comment-to-DM delivery.

## Summary
**`meta-flywheel-mcp`** is a zero-dependency Python engine and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for publishing technical stories across Facebook Pages, Instagram Professional, and Threads while fulfilling keyword comments via Meta's official Private Replies API. It enforces `<500` UTF-8 byte Threads auto-chaining, SQLite partial-retry idempotency, `<1ms` HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, and single-bubble DM delivery with `0 MB VRAM` overhead.

## MCP Command
`python3 -m meta_flywheel.mcp_server --mcp --dry-run` (manifest: `server.json`)

## Docs
- Getting Started: `docs/getting-started.md`

## Quick Start (python)
```python
from meta_flywheel import adapt_campaign_copy

payload = adapt_campaign_copy(
    brief="Our dashboard claimed 4.2x ROAS while net cash dropped by $14,200.",
    repo_url="https://github.com/cynthiaschomp/roas-to-cash-mcp",
    booking_url="https://cynthiaschomp.com/book",
    keyword="ROAS",
)
print(payload["threads"]["post_1_bytes"], payload["threads"]["post_2"])
```

## Data Flow
`Master Brief + Public URLs -> [Copy Adapter & 200-OK Gate] -> [SQLite Job Spine] -> FB / IG / Threads #1+#2 -> [HMAC Webhook + Self-Author Breaker] -> Atomic Private Reply DM`
